caption: The drawing depicts a single teapot centered on a plain, light-colored background. The teapot has a rounded, bulbous body with a slightly narrower base and lid. Its body features a mix of muted pinkish-brown, gray, and tan tones, giving it a textured, metallic appearance. The spout and handle are both elongated and curved, rendered in shades of gray and blue-gray, suggesting a metal material distinct from the body. The teapot lid is dome-shaped with concentric rings and a small knob on top, also colored in gray and blue-gray tones. The composition shows the teapot in profile, with spout facing left and handle to the right, and there are no other objects or decorative elements in the image. The artist's signature is visible in the lower right corner.
title: Pewter Teapot
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
